g.text: A layered evaluation contract separatesexecution from accepted work

g.text: Valid SQL within source permissions and query limits.
Complete keyed rows or multisets; preserve duplicates and NULLs. Define ordering, top-k ties and column-specific tolerances before grading.
Correct entity, metric, grain, denominator, date role, period, units and coverage.
Grounded definitions, helpful discovery, clarification, correct state changes and freshness.
Supported facts, useful questions, disclosed material gaps, approved material and acceptable rep effort.

Freeze the data/as-of; review reference SQL independently and permit alternative correct implementations.Calibrate LLM semantic judgments against adjudicated expert cases; keep the five dimensions inspectable.
Proposed evaluation framework; row counts remain a diagnostic rather than proof of answer correctness.
